scenario.name: ramp-cpu-ort
scenario.description: Task 5.5, one variable changed from ramp-cpu-pt: the detector backend, ONNX Runtime FP32 (E-046: 1.84x PyTorch model-only, same mAP), still one frame per forward pass. Containerized ingest + one yolo11n worker + Postgres + object store, data-mini at 5 FPS per camera (1280x720 q85), steps of 1 to 5 cameras (5 added over ramp-cpu in case 4 passes), warmup 20 s, hold 90 s, 3 repetitions, no query load. Start the worker with WORKER_BACKEND=onnxruntime WORKER_INFER_BATCH=1; expect_worker refuses any other configuration. Quiet host: nothing else CPU-heavy.
